onboarding_events_reason.name: onboarding_events_reason
onboarding_events_reason.value: CASE WHEN "onboarding_events"."event" = 'retired' THEN "onboarding_events"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("onboarding_events"."reason")) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 ELSE "onboarding_events"."reason" IS NULL OR length(trim("onboarding_events"."reason")) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 END

onboarding_validations_subject.name: onboarding_validations_subject
onboarding_validations_subject.value:
CASE "onboarding_validations"."subject"
      WHEN 'portal' THEN "onboarding_validations"."portal_revision_id" IS NOT NULL AND "onboarding_validations"."application_revision_id" IS NULL AND "onboarding_validations"."microfrontend_revision_id" IS NULL
      WHEN 'application' THEN "onboarding_validations"."application_revision_id" IS NOT NULL AND "onboarding_validations"."portal_revision_id" IS NULL AND "onboarding_validations"."microfrontend_revision_id" IS NULL
      WHEN 'microfrontend' THEN "onboarding_validations"."microfrontend_revision_id" IS NOT NULL AND "onboarding_validations"."portal_revision_id" IS NULL AND "onboarding_validations"."application_revision_id" IS NULL
      ELSE 0 END

placement_decisions_reason.name: placement_decisions_reason
placement_decisions_reason.value: CASE WHEN "placement_decisions"."decision" IN ('reject', 'retire') THEN "placement_decisions"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("placement_decisions"."reason")) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 ELSE "placement_decisions"."reason" IS NULL OR length(trim("placement_decisions"."reason")) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 END

placement_decisions_accepted.name: placement_decisions_accepted
placement_decisions_accepted.value:
CASE "placement_decisions"."decision"
        WHEN 'approve' THEN "placement_decisions"."accepted_route" IS NOT NULL AND length("placement_decisions"."accepted_route") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND "placement_decisions"."accepted_route" GLOB '/*' AND instr("placement_decisions"."accepted_route", '//') = 0 AND ("placement_decisions"."accepted_route" = '/' OR "placement_decisions"."accepted_route" NOT GLOB '*/') AND "placement_decisions"."accepted_route" NOT GLOB '*[?#]*' AND "placement_decisions"."accepted_route" NOT GLOB '*[^!-~]*' AND "placement_decisions"."accepted_label" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("placement_decisions"."accepted_label")) BETWEEN 1 AND 100
          AND "placement_decisions"."accepted_ordering" IS NOT NULL AND "placement_decisions"."accepted_ordering" BETWEEN 0 AND 100000 AND ("placement_decisions"."accepted_menu_parent_key" IS NULL OR length("placement_decisions"."accepted_menu_parent_key") BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND "placement_decisions"."accepted_menu_parent_key" GLOB '[a-z]*' AND "placement_decisions"."accepted_menu_parent_key" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*')
          AND "placement_decisions"."accepted_entitlements" IS NOT NULL AND json_valid("placement_decisions"."accepted_entitlements") AND json_type("placement_decisions"."accepted_entitlements") = 'object' AND length("placement_decisions"."accepted_entitlements") <= 262144 AND "placement_decisions"."accepted_defaults" IS NOT NULL AND json_valid("placement_decisions"."accepted_defaults") AND json_type("placement_decisions"."accepted_defaults") = 'array' AND length("placement_decisions"."accepted_defaults") <= 262144
        ELSE "placement_decisions"."accepted_route" IS NULL AND "placement_decisions"."accepted_menu_parent_key" IS NULL AND "placement_decisions"."accepted_label" IS NULL AND "placement_decisions"."accepted_ordering" IS NULL AND "placement_decisions"."accepted_entitlements" IS NULL AND "placement_decisions"."accepted_defaults" IS NULL END

placement_request_environments_environme.name: placement_request_environments_environment
placement_request_environments_environme.value: length("placement_request_environments"."environment") BETWEEN 1 AND 32 AND "placement_request_environments"."environment" GLOB '[a-z]*' AND "placement_request_environments"."environment" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*'

placement_requests_menu_parent.name: placement_requests_menu_parent
placement_requests_menu_parent.value: "placement_requests"."menu_parent_key" IS NULL OR length("placement_requests"."menu_parent_key") BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND "placement_requests"."menu_parent_key" GLOB '[a-z]*' AND "placement_requests"."menu_parent_key" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*'

placement_requests_route.name: placement_requests_route
placement_requests_route.value: length("placement_requests"."route") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND "placement_requests"."route" GLOB '/*' AND instr("placement_requests"."route", '//') = 0 AND ("placement_requests"."route" = '/' OR "placement_requests"."route" NOT GLOB '*/') AND "placement_requests"."route" NOT GLOB '*[?#]*' AND "placement_requests"."route" NOT GLOB '*[^!-~]*'

placement_routes_environment.name: placement_routes_environment
placement_routes_environment.value: length("placement_routes"."environment") BETWEEN 1 AND 32 AND "placement_routes"."environment" GLOB '[a-z]*' AND "placement_routes"."environment" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*'

placement_routes_route.name: placement_routes_route
placement_routes_route.value: length("placement_routes"."route") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND "placement_routes"."route" GLOB '/*' AND instr("placement_routes"."route", '//') = 0 AND ("placement_routes"."route" = '/' OR "placement_routes"."route" NOT GLOB '*/') AND "placement_routes"."route" NOT GLOB '*[?#]*' AND "placement_routes"."route" NOT GLOB '*[^!-~]*'

portal_default_routes_environment.name: portal_default_routes_environment
portal_default_routes_environment.value: length("portal_default_routes"."environment") BETWEEN 1 AND 32 AND "portal_default_routes"."environment" GLOB '[a-z]*' AND "portal_default_routes"."environment" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*'

portal_environments_environment.name: portal_environments_environment
portal_environments_environment.value: length("portal_environments"."environment") BETWEEN 1 AND 32 AND "portal_environments"."environment" GLOB '[a-z]*' AND "portal_environments"."environment" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*'

portal_environments_runtime.name: portal_environments_runtime
portal_environments_runtime.value: "portal_environments"."runtime" IS NULL OR (length("portal_environments"."runtime") BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND "portal_environments"."runtime" NOT GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9._@/-]*')

portal_environments_entitlements_digest.name: portal_environments_entitlements_digest
portal_environments_entitlements_digest.value: "portal_environments"."entitlements_digest" IS NULL OR (length("portal_environments"."entitlements_digest") = 64 AND "portal_environments"."entitlements_digest" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')

portal_environments_inherited.name: portal_environments_inherited
portal_environments_inherited.value: "portal_environments"."entitlements_inherited_from" IS NULL OR (length("portal_environments"."entitlements_inherited_from") BETWEEN 1 AND 32 AND "portal_environments"."entitlements_inherited_from" GLOB '[a-z]*' AND "portal_environments"."entitlements_inherited_from" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*' AND "portal_environments"."entitlements_inherited_from" <> "portal_environments"."environment")

portal_environments_legacy.name: portal_environments_legacy
portal_environments_legacy.value: ("portal_environments"."runtime" IS NULL) = ("portal_environments"."entitlements" IS NULL) AND ("portal_environments"."entitlements" IS NULL) = ("portal_environments"."entitlements_digest" IS NULL) AND ("portal_environments"."entitlements" IS NOT NULL OR "portal_environments"."entitlements_inherited_from" IS NULL)

portal_menu_groups_key.name: portal_menu_groups_key
portal_menu_groups_key.value: length("portal_menu_groups"."key") BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND "portal_menu_groups"."key" GLOB '[a-z]*' AND "portal_menu_groups"."key" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*'

portal_revisions_submission.name: portal_revisions_submission
portal_revisions_submission.value:
CASE "portal_revisions"."state"
      WHEN 'submitted' THEN "portal_revisions"."digest" IS NOT NULL AND length("portal_revisions"."digest") = 64 AND "portal_revisions"."digest" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND "portal_revisions"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "portal_revisions"."submitted_by" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("portal_revisions"."submitted_by")) BETWEEN 1 AND 200
      ELSE "portal_revisions"."digest" IS NULL AND "portal_revisions"."submitted_at" IS NULL AND "portal_revisions"."submitted_by" IS NULL END

portal_revisions_seal_id.name: portal_revisions_seal_id
portal_revisions_seal_id.value: "portal_revisions"."seal_id" IS NULL OR (length("portal_revisions"."seal_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND "portal_revisions"."seal_id" = trim("portal_revisions"."seal_id"))

portal_revisions_frozen.name: portal_revisions_frozen
portal_revisions_frozen.value:
CASE "portal_revisions"."state" WHEN 'submitted' THEN "portal_revisions"."owner_team" IS NOT NULL AND CASE "portal_revisions"."format_version"
          WHEN 1 THEN "portal_revisions"."runtimes" IS NOT NULL AND json_valid("portal_revisions"."runtimes") AND json_type("portal_revisions"."runtimes") = 'array'
            AND "portal_revisions"."contract" IS NOT NULL AND json_valid("portal_revisions"."contract") AND "portal_revisions"."contract_digest" IS NOT NULL AND length("portal_revisions"."contract_digest") = 64 AND "portal_revisions"."contract_digest" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND "portal_revisions"."environment_catalog_source" IS NULL AND "portal_revisions"."environment_catalog_digest" IS NULL
          WHEN 2 THEN "portal_revisions"."runtimes" IS NULL AND "portal_revisions"."contract" IS NULL AND "portal_revisions"."contract_digest" IS NULL AND "portal_revisions"."environment_catalog_source" IN ('studio', 'fallback') AND "portal_revisions"."environment_catalog_digest" IS NOT NULL AND length("portal_revisions"."environment_catalog_digest") = 64 AND "portal_revisions"."environment_catalog_digest" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
          ELSE 0 END
        ELSE "portal_revisions"."runtimes" IS NULL AND "portal_revisions"."contract" IS NULL AND "portal_revisions"."contract_digest" IS NULL AND "portal_revisions"."environment_catalog_source" IS NULL AND "portal_revisions"."environment_catalog_digest" IS NULL END

jobs_lease.name: jobs_lease
jobs_lease.value: ("jobs"."state" = 'running') = ("jobs"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "jobs"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

demo_applications_bitbucket.name: demo_applications_bitbucket
demo_applications_bitbucket.value: ("demo_applications"."environment" = 'dev' AND "demo_applications"."bitbucket_project" IS NOT NULL AND "demo_applications"."bitbucket_repository" IS NOT NULL) OR ("demo_applications"."environment" = 'sandbox' AND "demo_applications"."bitbucket_project" IS NULL AND "demo_applications"."bitbucket_repository" IS NULL)
